categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: aviation military products, sensing and control products, intelligent transportation, and others. It focuses on aircraft measurement and control products, power distribution products, hanging and delivery systems, strain gauges, strain sensors, weighing instruments and software, intelligent sensors, consumer electronics, intelligent logistics equipment, industrial weighing control, vehicle inspection, special vehicle inspection, intelligent driver training, intelligent traffic information systems, ZOS management software, and electromagnetic valves.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages intelligent measurement and control core technologies, integrating advanced design and manufacturing capabilities. It emphasizes R&D in electronic common technologies, intelligent thin-film sensors, high-precision strain gauges, anti-shock force sensors, digital strain gauges, and intelligent warehouse distribution systems. The company also develops embedded multi-device data synchronization, high-precision flow control proportional electromagnetic valves, and advanced weighing and sensing technologies, supported by extensive patents and international certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include military and civil aviation sectors, industrial measurement and control industries, intelligent transportation authorities, and consumer electronics markets. The company serves domestic and international clients, including major aviation manufacturers and defense contractors, as well as sectors requiring high-end sensors and intelligent logistics solutions. The company also targets emerging markets such as low-altitude economy, new battlefield industries, and digital intelligence industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for about 75% of revenue, and expanding international markets representing approximately 25%. Key operational locations include Shaanxi Province (Hanzhong), Sichuan Province (Chengdu), and subsidiaries in Xi'an, Shijiazhuang, Shanghai, and other regions. The company also engages in overseas markets through exports and international partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace and sensing industries, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of aircraft components, sensors, and intelligent control systems. It acts as a key supplier of aviation equipment and sensing solutions, providing products and system solutions to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and end users in aerospace and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the aviation main business, advancing intelligent measurement and control technologies, and expanding into emerging sectors such as digital intelligence, intelligent transportation, and new battlefield industries. The company invests over 10% of revenue in R&D, focusing on innovation in sensor technologies, intelligent logistics, digital operation systems (ZOS), and aviation cargo logistics equipment. It also emphasizes talent development, governance enhancement, and digital transformation to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products and system solutions across its business segments. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance, with a focus on product sales in aviation military products, sensing control, intelligent transportation, and related services. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic aerospace measurement and control industry, supported by strong R&D capabilities, extensive product certifications, and a broad product portfolio. It competes with other aerospace and sensing equipment manufacturers in China and internationally, leveraging its integration with the China Aviation Industry Corporation (AVIC) group. The company benefits from high entry barriers in the aerospace sector due to technology intensity and regulatory requirements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.78 billion, a 6.11% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 112.3 million, up 14.41%. Total assets reached about RMB 4.24 billion, growing 6.69% from the previous year. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory with increased R&D investment exceeding 10% of revenue and expanding international sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, intelligent measurement and control solutions with strong technological innovation, comprehensive product certifications (including OIML, CE, NEPSI, ATEX), and a wide range of patented technologies. It offers integrated design and manufacturing capabilities, high cost-performance products, and tailored system solutions for both military and civilian aviation sectors. Its strategic alignment with national defense modernization and digital intelligence trends enhances its competitive differentiation.
